title: Expose API gateway hostname and harden Worker edge caching

endpoints.before: The API gateway Worker was not bound to `api.egdata.app`; legacy responses forwarded through the Worker passed origin CORS and freshness headers through unchanged, and no Worker edge cache served these responses.
endpoints.after: The Worker is now bound to `api.egdata.app` for legacy gateway requests. Forwarded responses set caller-specific CORS headers and eligible GET/HEAD responses may be served from the post-authentication Worker edge cache with a route-specific public max-age instead of the origin CDN-Cache-Control header. Authentication, permissions, quota admission, response bodies, status codes, and error contracts are unchanged.
